# Skill template

Copy this directory to `skills/<your-skill>/` and replace the
placeholders. Delete this paragraph once the skill is real.

## Reference material

Replace these with the systems your skill actually touches:

- [Team runbook](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/runbooks/your-service) — the
  runbook for the service this skill operates.
- [Dashboard](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/dashboards/your-service) — where
  to watch the effect of a change.

## Steps

1. Describe the first action the agent should take.
2. Describe how it verifies the result.
3. State the stop condition.
